title: Trowser Scenario
description: Schema for .trw (Trowser scenario) files. Primary format: `phases` (setup → trigger → oracle → cleanup) executed via POST /api/test-scenario or POST /api/security/verify-workflow. Legacy flat `steps[]` still supported.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for IDE validation.

name.description: Human-readable label for this scenario (displayed in Trowser's script console output).

stopOnError.description: When true (default), stop executing after the first step that fails. Set to false to continue and collect all results.

maxSteps.description: Hard cap on the number of steps. The server enforces an absolute maximum of 500.

pacingMs.description: Optional global delay in milliseconds between steps (after the first). Adds to each step’s own `delay`. Use on WAF-protected sites. Same as `globalDelay`.

globalDelay.description: Alias for `pacingMs` — extra wait between scenario steps.

identitiesRequired.description: Named identities required before running (Phase 1+ identity capture/apply). Informational until identity steps ship.

phases.description: Phased proof workflow (setup → trigger → oracle → cleanup). Oracle failure = scenario failure. Requires safetyMode active on POST /api/test-scenario.

safetyMode.description: Required active (or aggressive) for phased proof scenarios.

exportEvidence.description: When true, write evidence bundle after oracle evaluation.

steps.description: Ordered list of API calls to execute. Steps from a file are executed first; inline steps (via POST body) are appended.

identityStep.description: Identity orchestration step (no method/path). Runs capture or apply against stored snapshots.

chainCategory.description: Normalized finding category for chain-findings and chain analysis.

path.description: Trowser API endpoint path (e.g. /api/navigate, /api/click). Case-insensitive. Nested /api/test-scenario and /mcp are rejected at runtime.

id.description: Optional label for this step. Shown in console output and returned in results for easy identification.

query.description: Query parameters — either a string ("a=1&b=2" or "?a=1&b=2") or an object ({"a": "1"}). Object values (strings, numbers, booleans) are stringified automatically.

body.description: Request body for POST/DELETE steps. Can be a JSON object (most common) or a JSON-encoded string. String values may contain {{varName}} placeholders that are replaced from captured variables.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait before executing this step. Useful for SPAs that need time to settle after a previous action. Maximum 30000 (30 seconds).

capture.description: Capture values from the response into named variables for use in subsequent steps via {{varName}} placeholders. Keys are variable names, values are dot-path expressions into the response JSON (e.g. "data.path", "data.results[0].id"). Capture only runs on successful steps.
